label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: The first keyboard focus sat on a shipping-destination pop-up whose Tab key did not move on; only Escape got me out of it.
The cookie banner buttons were five Tab presses away, behind links, and focus did not start inside the banner.
A newsletter discount pop-up appeared on its own while I was tabbing, then focus jumped to a product link I never chose.
Size buttons in the quick view had no name, and pressing them gave no sign that anything was selected, so I could not tell what I had done.
Many Tab stops stood between the page top and the size buttons: header, then each product image as its own stop, then reviews, color, size guide.
Choosing a size did not announce that Add to Bag had appeared, and I had to Tab past every other size to reach it; sold-out [name] was only marked in its label.
The Continue to Checkout button was about ten Tab stops down, after quantity, save, edit, remove, Afterpay and discount controls; Enter on it gave no message while the checkout page loaded.
